generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a game-ready-looking FOUR-DIRECTION STATIC IDLE CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET, transparent PNG, matching the approved pixel characters of this same cute RPG.
Input reference roles: image 1 is the ONLY source of the character identity, colors, outfit and signature details; image 2 (white-haired red priestess) and image 3 (purple-hatted magician) are ONLY visual-style references for block size, chibi proportions, outlines and the 2x2 four-direction layout. Never borrow their accessories or costumes.
LAYOUT: exactly FOUR full-body figures, arranged as an even 2x2 grid. TOP LEFT true frontal view facing screen down, TOP RIGHT true back view facing away, BOTTOM LEFT strict left-facing profile, BOTTOM RIGHT strict right-facing profile. Full head and feet in each cell; equal height/scale, shared baseline within row; center each figure in its cell, leave comfortable transparent padding and wide separation. No animation steps, no labels, no grid lines.
PIXEL STYLE IS CRITICAL: actual deliberately chunky low-resolution pixel drawing, visible enlarged square pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes like images 2 and 3, approximately 60-70 logical source pixels tall for each figure. Strong dark one-source-pixel outline, flat color areas with two or three shadow tones, simplified major hair tufts and cloth folds, crisp blocky eyes, no tiny illustrative details. Cute chibi about 2.5 heads tall, softly rounded jaw and compact SLIM body. Do not draw high-resolution anime with a merely jagged outline; internal details must also have large pixel blocks. No smooth antialias, gradients, brush texture, glossy rendered highlights or dithering.
The four directions must be genuinely distinct views of the SAME asymmetric character. Turn accessories with the body and observe near/far-side occlusion. Do not mirror both profiles blindly. Back must not show facial features or front necktie.
Backdrop: genuine alpha transparency outside the sprites including between limbs/coat tails. No ground plane, shadow, border, UI, captions, watermark, weapons or extra characters.
CHARACTER: HERTZ / 赫兹, the red-suited microphone presenter in image 1. Preserve the cute original female character, mischievously cheerful, not a muscular adult man.
Hair and face: rich crimson-red chin-length bob with short outward tips, distinctive thick WHITE forelock/pale streak swooping down through the front fringe; turquoise/cyan eyes, a small friendly smile. Keep the visible small WHITE EARPIECE in her anatomical LEFT ear (screen-right in frontal view); simplify its pale cable if needed.
Outfit: elegant dark crimson-red LONG TAILCOAT, clearly divided two tapering tails hanging behind legs near ankles; fitted jacket lapels; white pointed shirt collar and cuffs; dark brown/charcoal tie with a GOLD LIGHTNING BOLT clip on chest; golden yellow waistcoat visible at waist; fitted charcoal-brown TROUSERS, never a skirt; WHITE ankle boots with high turned cuffs and a narrow GOLD toe stripe.
Important prop: hold a GOLD vintage rounded-rectangular microphone with 3-4 DARK horizontal grille slots in anatomical RIGHT hand, at chest/upper belly height, small pale cable looping close to body. Not a ladle, torch or ice cream. Quiet standing pose, right forearm bent holding microphone, left arm resting across waist as in the source. In back view mostly hide microphone by torso, but retain hand/edge only when physically visible. Front-left profile (left-facing, visible character LEFT side) show white ear earpiece; opposite profile partly occludes it. Hair, earpiece and microphone never swap anatomical sides.
Preserve all key motifs at coarse sprite scale with minimum pixels. Match image 2/3 character detail density exactly, including compact feet and leg length.

note: 提示词中的60–70逻辑像素高度和有限色阶仅为美术目标；未通过脚本重采样、量化或编辑图像。
